text: 【商务部：1-6月，我国批发和零售业增加值7.2万亿元】据商务部消息，商务部流通发展司负责人谈2026年1-6月我国批发和零售业发展情况。1-6月，我国批发和零售业增加值7.2万亿元，同比增长3.7%，占GDP比重为10.4%。我国批发和零售业发展稳中有进，为全方位扩大国内需求、建设强大国内市场提供有力支撑。
text_en: [Ministry of Commerce: From January to June, the added value of China's wholesale and retail industries was 7.2 trillion yuan] According to the Ministry of Commerce, the head of the Circulation Development Department commented on the development of China's wholesale and retail industries in the first half of 2026. From January to June, the added value of China's wholesale and retail industries was 7.2 trillion yuan, up 3.7% year-on-year, accounting for 10.4% of GDP. China's wholesale and retail industries are developing steadily with progress, providing strong support for comprehensively expanding domestic demand and building a strong domestic market.
